label: integral component of membrane / plasma membrane
recommended_action: lead: add with ISS/ISM, qualify compartment
basis: Single TM plus signal peptide plus positive-inside delta +11 support an integral type I membrane protein. The specific membrane is not determined by sequence; plasma membrane is the family default and needs verification

label: side of membrane (cytoplasmic side) for the tail
recommended_action: lead: supporting detail, not a standalone annotation
basis: Topology places residues 126-1133, including the PPPY, in the cytoplasm

label: protein binding
recommended_action: lead: avoid as the final term
basis: Supported by PMID 14605208 but uninformative; use a more specific child if a partner class is confirmed

label: WW domain binding
recommended_action: lead: strongest candidate MF, needs experimental verification
basis: An invariant cytoplasmic PPPY with a di-acidic flank, fully exposed in ortholog models, plus one Y2H record with the WW protein Kibra. No direct binding assay exists, so this is a lead, not an annotation-ready call

label: cell adhesion molecule binding / E3 ligase binding
basis: Family membership (DGCR2/IDD, VWFC) points to adhesion; motif architecture matching PMID 16531238 points to a Nedd4-family WW domain

label: hippo signaling
basis: The only WW link is Kibra by Y2H. The CG42404 flank does not match the Yorkie-binding PY motifs of Expanded, Warts, Hippo, Tgi or NcoA6

label: protein ubiquitination
basis: A PY motif makes a protein a candidate Nedd4 substrate, which is a prediction about the protein's regulation, not a demonstrated activity

label: protein glycosylation
recommended_action: lead: do not add; actively argues against N-glycosylation annotation
basis: Zero N-X-S/T sequons in the 84-residue ectodomain; all 8 sequons are cytoplasmic
